tools.name: drug_price
tools.description: Looks up what US pharmacies actually pay to acquire a drug (the CMS NADAC benchmark, per unit, with its date; for a pen, syringe, autoinjector or cartridge priced per mL whose description states what one holds, nadac.per_container gives the price of one, with container, ml and usd, as candidates and

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: drug_price · Private data: drug_price · Public sink: drug_price.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: drug_price · Private data: drug_price · Public sink: drug_price

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
